title: builtin.cond.enemy_in_range parameters
description: Succeeds when at least one hostile contact is within range_m meters. Hostile means both entities have a force and the forces differ; entities without a force are neutral and never hostile. The nearest hostile contact (ties: lowest entity id) can be stored in a blackboard key.

range_m.description: Maximum distance in meters (3D range of the contact, inclusive).

store_as.description: Optional blackboard key of type entity that receives the nearest hostile contact on success. The key must be declared in the graph's [blackboard] table. Left unchanged on failure.
